title: powertoys can no longer update automatically
author: Sec-Joe

judgment.rationale: The live screenshots and discussion identify the documented one-time updater transition from the legacy 0.100 version format to 0.101; the same behavior is tracked by Issue 50240 and requires one manual update.
evidence: The affected installation is PowerToys 0.100.2 using PowerToys auto-update.
The reporter asks why no automatic update is offered and a commenter points to the release notes.
Issue 50240 tracks the same legacy version-parser transition and manual recovery.
No issue-specific code change or new failure signature is present.
judgment.recommended_action: Consolidate as handled by Issue 50240 and provide precise one-time manual-update guidance.

fix_assessment.rationale: This open bug is a duplicate/handled instance of the documented 0.100-to-0.101 updater transition, not a distinct current PowerToys code-fix opportunity.

issue_context.summary: PowerToys 0.100.2 cannot automatically cross the documented updater version-format transition introduced with 0.101.
known_information: The report concerns PowerToys 0.100.2 and the PowerToys auto-update path.
The issue has two comments, including a release-note reference.
Issue 50240 covers the same transition and manual recovery path.
The issue remains open but has no assignee or linked implementation.
inferences: The failure is expected for this legacy client during the one-time transition rather than evidence of a new updater regression.
A manual installation of the current release should move the client onto the current updater-compatible format.
issue_context.analysis: The issue body and discussion already identify the known release transition. A competing fix plan would duplicate handled work and could misrepresent a compatibility limitation as a new regression.
initial_investigation: Reviewed the complete issue body, both live comments, labels, assignees, and linked-work state.
Compared the report with Issue 50240 and the release-note explanation referenced in discussion.
Reviewed updater/version-format history in the local PowerToys clone; no distinct current fix is indicated.

actions.label: Post 0.101 manual-update guidance

comment.body: Thanks for the screenshots. This matches the known one-time update transition tracked in Issue 50240: older PowerToys clients cannot complete the normal automatic update after the release version format changed for 0.101. Please install the current PowerToys release manually once from the official release or Microsoft Store; automatic updates should resume from that current version. The release-note warning referenced above documents the same transition.

actions.note: Draft only; no upstream comment is posted.
